MEMO — UK Travel Spend (GL 6300), Q1 2026
Prepared by: david.murguia@gmail.com | Date: 2026-04-03
Requested by: UK Managing Director

ANSWER
UK entity travel expense (GL 6300) for Q1 2026 was GBP 4,591.73. British Airways is by far the largest merchant at GBP 3,669.27, or 79.9% of the total.

BASIS
Ledger only — UK entity, account 6300 (Travel), 2026-01-01 through 2026-03-31. 19 posted journal entries, all card-sourced and all carrying support. The entry detail ties exactly to the GL account balance (Jan 1,376.38 + Feb 1,649.47 + Mar 1,565.88 = 4,591.73 cumulative ending balance), so the analysis below is complete with no reconciling items.

BY MONTH (GBP)
  Jan 2026   1,376.38
  Feb 2026   1,649.47
  Mar 2026   1,565.88
  Q1 total   4,591.73

BY MERCHANT (GBP)
  British Airways (airfare)   3,669.27   79.9%
  Premier Inn (hotel)           460.98   10.0%
  Addison Lee (taxi)            348.58    7.6%
  Trainline (rail)              112.90    2.5%
  Total                       4,591.73  100.0%

BRITISH AIRWAYS DETAIL — the driver
  JE-00041  2026-01-08  Airfare                         182.55
  JE-00072  2026-01-21  Airfare London-New York         640.00
  JE-00083  2026-01-24  Airfare                         149.80
  JE-00142  2026-02-06  Airfare                         145.52
  JE-00151  2026-02-09  Airfare                         453.38
  JE-00166  2026-02-17  Airfare London-New York         712.40
  JE-00230  2026-03-02  Airfare                         451.50
  JE-00257  2026-03-10  Airfare London-New York         588.00
  JE-00275  2026-03-19  Airfare                         346.12
  Subtotal                                            3,669.27
Three London-New York long-haul tickets (JE-00072, JE-00166, JE-00257) total GBP 1,940.40 on their own — 42% of all Q1 travel — and explain most of the British Airways concentration. BA spend also rose steadily month over month (Jan 972.35, Feb 1,311.30, Mar 1,385.62).

OTHER MERCHANTS — supporting entries
  Premier Inn:   JE-00074 (01-21, 238.65); JE-00145 (02-07, 222.33)
  Addison Lee:   JE-00042 (01-08, 65.82); JE-00046 (01-10, 24.60); JE-00097 (01-27, 74.96); JE-00127 (02-03, 70.13); JE-00172 (02-19, 45.71); JE-00258 (03-11, 32.48); JE-00285 (03-23, 34.88)
  Trainline:     JE-00246 (03-07, 112.90)

NOTES AND CAVEATS
1. The March 2026 close is still in progress as of the date of this memo. The March figure of GBP 1,565.88 reflects posted activity only; any late-arriving travel accrual or expense report booked before the period is closed would increase the Q1 total. The figures should be treated as preliminary until March is locked.
2. All amounts are in GBP, the UK entity's functional currency, as recorded in the ledger. No FX translation was applied and none was required.
3. All 19 entries are posted, card-sourced, and supported; no unsupported items were identified in GL 6300 for the quarter, so no exceptions were flagged and no journal entries were required for this request.
4. This was a read-only reporting request. No entries were posted, no checklist items were changed, and no bank matching was performed.
